summary: V7 import gate switched to ENFORCE mode. V10 UI is clean.

before_after.before: Gate in REPORT mode, 9 V7 refs counted but not enforced
before_after.after: Gate in ENFORCE mode, 0 violations (barrel explicitly allowlisted)

design_decision.barrel_policy: v10/components/index.ts is INTENTIONALLY allowed to re-export V7
design_decision.rationale: This is the controlled migration pathway. V10 consumers import from barrel, then we migrate components one-by-one.
design_decision.enforcement: Actual V10 components/pages/hooks must NOT import from v7 directly
